title: Kluang Half Marathon 2026 Review: Johor's Coffee-Town 21K
seo_title: Kluang Half Marathon 2026 Review | Johor Malaysia Race
meta_description: The Kluang Half Marathon 2026: September 20 at Kluang Stadium, Johor. A single-distance 21.1K in Malaysia's coffee capital — registration now closed.
dek: Set for 20 September 2026 at Kluang Stadium in Johor — Malaysia's coffee-producing heartland — this single-distance half marathon is now closed for registration.
verdict: The Kluang Half Marathon is a focused, single-distance 21.1K in Kluang, Johor — a town best known for its coffee production and its railway-station kopitiam culture. The single-distance format keeps the event streamlined. Registration is now closed. Kluang sits roughly 2 hours north of Singapore, making it accessible for cross-border runners. September in Johor is the tail of the southwest monsoon — warm and humid with possible afternoon thunderstorms.
